A quiet narrative-management game at a small Korean mountain shrine at night, frontal composition: a curved dark tiled roof, a beam painted in muted dancheong colors, wooden lattice doors glowing faintly with warm paper light, misty blue mountains and moonlight behind. On the altar stand three dark wooden memorial tablets with partly missing vertical names shown as empty circles, and behind each a translucent glowing spirit in flowing robes — pale blue, warm gold, faint jade — the middle one brightest with a halo. Six candles flicker, incense smoke curls, yellow paper talismans with red marks hang on pillars, a sacred tree on the left wears a straw rope with five-color cloth strips, low mist drifts. A glowing paper slip reading '첫눈' floats toward the middle tablet on a thread of light. Bottom-left a torn cream wish paper '소원지' in serif Korean with underlined name fragments; bottom-right a dark tray '찾은 이름 조각' with yellow paper slips '우물가', '첫눈', '징검다리'. Vertical serif title '이름 없는 신당' at top-left. Ink blue, candle amber, paper yellow, vermilion seal, grain. Correction: the tablets show no invented name syllables — left and right tablets show only empty circles '○○○', the middle tablet shows '○○○ ○○ 할미'. The wish paper text has blanks that match the found fragments, e.g. '그해 ___에서 ___을 맞던 할미' (blanks for 우물가 and 첫눈); no other names such as 연, 희, 강.

The same Korean mountain shrine at dawn, bittersweet: pink-gold morning mist, the lattice doors folded open to a hazy valley, most candles burned down to stubs with thin smoke, only three still lit. In the center a soft beam of light rises from the altar and a translucent golden spirit dissolves upward into drifting paper motes and petals; beside the beam, large vertical dark-ink calligraphy reads '우물가 첫눈 할미', the completed name. The left tablet stands blank, and on the right only one faint jade spirit remains. The five-color cloth strips on the sacred tree stir in the breeze. A tilted cream note on the right '위패 뒤에 남은 쪽지' with a short farewell signed '— 할미'. Bottom center serif caption '이름을 찾은 신은 떠난다' and three small cards '떠난 신 일곱', '남은 신 둘', '남은 초 세 자루'. Warm rose, peach and gold with soft plum shadows, gentle glow, paper grain, quiet emotional mood. Correction: exactly three candles are lit on the altar; every other candle is a burnt-out stub with a thin smoke wisp and no flame, matching the card '남은 초 세 자루'.
